title: A planner run may plan round 0 in parts at the same time, split by page groups and merged into one plan
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Part 1 plans the whole site alone; page groups are cut in kit order into balanced parts over the others, the same way every time.
Each part starts from the run's first message and names its groups, or the whole site for part 1, which alone plans site, mainMenu and sharedBlocks.
The merge keeps part 1's whole-site fields, each part's own groups and pages in kit order, and drops menu entries for pages no part kept.

tests: the first part plans the whole site alone; page groups are cut in kit order over the others, the same way every time
each part starts from the run first message and is told its groups; the first plans the whole site and no group
the merged plan takes the whole site from part 1, each other part its own groups and pages in kit order
